ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 25% low-intensity black pixels localized at the periphery, median notch, and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupying the interior of both lobes. Significant black pigmentation mapping along the leading edges and trailing margins. A dense vertical black band bisects the fluke at the median notch, extending towards the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-degree angle and deep indentation relative to the trailing edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from shallow waves to sharp peaks, most pronounced at the mid-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, tapering into narrow, upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast pixel rings (rosette scars) visible: two prominent clusters on the mid-left lobe and one located on the right lobe near the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of dark, sub-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the lower interior portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy, irregular pixel-dense clusters at the distal tips of both lobes indicating significant barnacle colonization; large-scale black pigmentation field at the fluke-peduncle attachment point.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small dark-intensity 'fleck' spots distributed across the white ventral surface, particularly on the left lobe.
